Class CityRepository

java.lang.Object
repositories.CityRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CityRepository extends Object implements Serializable
A repository class responsible for managing and storing a collection of cities. This class provides methods for adding new cities, retrieving existing cities, and validating city-related data, such as uniqueness of names and positions.

    • isBlockPositionUnique

      public boolean isBlockPositionUnique(String map, HouseBlock b)
      Checks if the position of a given HouseBlock is unique within the specified map. A position is considered unique if no other HouseBlock in any city on the same map has the same coordinates.
      Parameters:
      map - Name of the map within which the uniqueness of the block's position is checked
      b - HouseBlock whose position's uniqueness is to be verified
      Returns:
      true if the block's position is unique within the specified map; false otherwise

    • validateBlock

      public CreateCityController.BlockError validateBlock(String map, HouseBlock b)
      Validates a HouseBlock within the context of a specified map. The method checks for potential issues such as position conflicts, alignment constraints, or other validation criteria specific to the map and block.
      Parameters:
      map - Name of the map where the block is to be validated.
      b - HouseBlock object to be validated.
      Returns:
      An instance of CreateCityController.BlockError, indicating the result of the validation. This may include error codes representing issues like non-unique positions or successful validation.
